# Vicent Sellés Álamo

**Conductor, Composer and Clarinetist**

![Vicent Sellés Álamo conducting](https://ik.imagekit.io/javiferdev/VICENT/VICENT-103.jpg?updatedAt=1787689025023)

Vicent Sellés Álamo was born in Villajoyosa in 1996. He holds a Higher Music Degree specializing in Clarinet (Performance) from the Valencia Conservatory of Music, and spent his third year of studies at the “Koninklijk Conservatorium” in Brussels as an exchange student through the Erasmus+ programme. During this period, he studied with professors Juan Ramón Beltrán, Carlos Lacruz, Benjamin Dieltjens and Emilio Ferrando. He also holds a Master’s Degree in Research and Performance from the Alicante Conservatory of Music, completed under the supervision of José Francisco Fernández Vicedo. He studied Wind Band Conducting at the Castilla-La Mancha Higher Conservatory with professors Rafa García, Pablo Marqués and Krastin Nastev. He is currently continuing his studies in this specialization at the Conservatorio Superior Progreso Musical. In the field of composition, he has also studied with composer and professor Saül Gómez. He is currently pursuing a Higher Degree in Composition at the Alicante Conservatory of Music.

## Training and Conducting

As a conductor, he has participated in conducting courses with professors and conductors such as Carlos Garcés, Miguel Etchegoncelay, José Rafael Pascual Vilaplana, José Alberto Pina, Paulo Martins, Óscar Navarro, José Vicente Algado and Tobias Gossmann. He has been guest conductor of the Lira Orxetana and the symphonic band of the Ateneo Musical de Villajoyosa. He is currently the principal conductor of the symphonic band of the Agrupación Musicomunicipal Sta. Ma Magdalena de Poble Nou de Benitatxell. Until July 2025, he was principal conductor of the Banda Jove del Ateneo Musical de Villajoyosa, with which he recorded the CD “Festera i Jove”, featuring a repertoire of Moros y Cristianos music originally written for youth wind band.

![Vicent Sellés Álamo in concert](https://ik.imagekit.io/javiferdev/VICENT/VICENT-30.jpg?updatedAt=1787689024686)

## Composition

As a composer, particularly in the symphonic field, he won First Prize at the 5th Arturo Balaguer “el de Canya” Composition Competition in La Pobla de Vallbona with his work “Pucciniana”, as well as Second Prize at the “I Centenari Musical de l’Ermita del Santíssim Crist del Remei de Finestrat” Music Composition Competition with his composition “(RE)m(E)i”.

Within the field of festive music, he has written numerous works, including: “125 Anys de Cordó”, a Moorish march awarded First Prize at the 1st “125 Aniversari Moros del Cordó de Mutxamel” Festive Music Composition Competition; “Tio Gabi”, a pasodoble awarded First Prize at the 3rd “Pasqual Pérez Choví” Composition Competition in Alginet; “Victoria Moya Martínez”, a pasodoble awarded Second Prize at the 3rd Pasodoble Competition of the Patron Saints’ Queens of Segorbe; “Catal”, a Christian march that was a finalist at the 8th Mutxamel Composition Competition; “Aguiló”, a Christian march that was a finalist at the 4th Agost Festive Music Composition Competition; and “Tempesta Aràbiga”, a Moorish march that was a finalist at the 19th “Villa de Benidorm” Festive Music Composition Competition.

He also receives annual commissions for the Moros y Cristianos festivities in different towns and cities. His catalogue of works also includes symphonic music, music for dolçaina ensembles and chamber music. He has attended composition masterclasses with Ernesto Aurignac, Stephen Melillo, Vicente Ortiz, Tomàs Gilabert, Joan Valent, Ricardo Llorca, Carlos Pellicer, Pedro Salinas and José Suñer, among others.

![Vicent Sellés Álamo composing](https://ik.imagekit.io/javiferdev/VICENT/VICENT-86.jpg?updatedAt=1787689024775)

## Clarinet and Teaching

As a clarinetist, he has studied with internationally renowned professors and performers such as Vicent Alberola, Yehuda Gilad, Ángel Belda, Enrique Pérez, Eduardo Raimundo, Sabine Meyer, Reiner Wehle, Hermann Stefansson, Andreas Sundén, Julien Hervé, Wolfgang Meyer, Javier Ros, Antonio Lapaz, Francisco Ferrer, Luis Miguel Méndez, Nikita Vaganov, Tamás Massanyi and Barbara Borowicz, among others.

In 2019, he participated as a resident artist at the Aurora Music Festival in Sweden, where he performed under renowned international conductors such as Jukka-Pekka Saraste and Johannes Gustavsson, and shared the stage with distinguished performers such as pianist Elisabeth Leonskaja.

He has performed with various ensembles and orchestras, including the Aurora Music Festival Orchestra, the Philharmonic Orchestra of the University of Alicante, the Eutherpe Orchestra, the Marina Alta Orchestra, Sinfonietta Altea, the Alicante Municipal Band, the Orchestra of the “Koninklijk Conservatorium” of Brussels, the Marina Baixa Chamber Orchestra and the Alicante Province Youth Orchestra, among others.

He has teaching experience in clarinet, music theory, choir, instrumental ensemble, harmony and analysis at music schools and conservatories in the provinces of Alicante and Valencia. He is a member of the Interim Teaching Staff of Music and Performing Arts of the Valencian Community, specializing in clarinet, and currently teaches clarinet at the Professional Conservatory of Elche.

![Vicent Sellés Álamo teaching](https://ik.imagekit.io/javiferdev/VICENT/VICENT-82.jpg?updatedAt=1787689024319)
